morphling_waveform.desc: Morphling turns into a wave and surges toward the target point, damaging every enemy in his path once. He cannot be harmed while surging. Clicking beyond the range sends him the full distance.

morphling_adaptive_strike_agi.desc: Hurls a blast of water at an enemy. Damage grows with Agility, most when Agility clearly exceeds Strength; the stun and knockback grow with Strength the same way.

morphling_morph_agi.desc: Toggle: steadily moves points from Strength into Agility while it costs mana. Learning it also levels Attribute Shift (Strength Gain).

morphling_morph_str.desc: Toggle: steadily moves points from Agility into Strength while it costs mana. Learning it also levels Attribute Shift (Agility Gain).

morphling_replicate.desc: Morphling becomes a copy of another hero, Warcraft heroes included: he takes its look and its basic abilities but keeps his own attributes. Morph Replicate switches between the two forms until the time runs out.

morphling_ebb_and_flow.desc: Strength gives Morphling bonus cast range and slow resistance; Agility gives bonus attack range and movement speed. The bonuses stay while he is morphed.

aub1: Switch between Morphling's own form and the copied hero while Morph lasts.
